### Forest: Focus for Productivity {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 18 февр. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _claireac1234_, 18 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve been a Forest user for many years now and have always enjoyed the cute trees and the incentive to put my phone down. The new UX that was just rolled out has so many pop-ups and distractions, and is flooding the app with monetization and pushes to pay a premium subscription for an app that I ALREADY PAID FOR. The value of Forest was in part the cost up front for an ad-free, push-free experience. The new UX makes this so much worse by making you go through multiple layers of pop-ups and questions to do a basic function. It has moved the obvious controls to unintuitive locations. Very disappointed to have an app that has been useful (and that I paid for!) ruined like this."
            2. _清辰戌_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The APP is too expensive!!!"
            3. _Noor_75_, 29 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 9 июл. 2026 г. - 17 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _TDTW!_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
            2. _w y_, 9 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "paid for forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
<!--/ir-theme-->

            1. _Jess_, 13 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "can't cancel subscription"
            2. _written11_, 11 июн. 2026 г., 3/5: "It’s a great app and I definitely recommend it to anyone who is motivated by gamification. It’s a little confusing to navigate at first, but great once you get the hang of it. However if you want to collect all the pets and such, you have no choice but to subscribe. Pet quests can be gained if you join a party with people who have subscriptions, but for pets that can’t be obtained through quests you’re basically screwed. Challenges can give you gem rewards, but chances of winning are very slim. I would love if gems were purchasable with coins but were very expensive per gem to encourage people to either grind for them or subscribe. That being said I can see how that could be abused with FCV and spamming habits, so if that were implemented those things would need to be adjusted and capped. But I do think it’s doable and less scammy, and honestly a more motivating option. I’ve fallen off Habitica a lot because when those things are unattainable there’s little incentive to actually use the app TL;DR: Good app overall but in my opinion the motivating factors are not sustainable. Claims not to be a pay to win game but absolutely is one if you want to collect things, which is the main reward system of the game. Needs adjustments"

### Fabulous {#review-app-5}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      14 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 22 февр. 2026 г. - 18 июл. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _CookiesPrincess21_, 18 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve had to block various accounts from trying to charge my card. Each with a different amount each time, even after blocking and changing my card number they continue to attempt to charge my card. I canceled my subscription months ago and they’re still attempting to charge."
            2. _Brooke the child_, 15 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "This app keeps trying to charge me after I have cancelled. TG I put in my Apple Cash as payment when I did a trial or I’d have to fight every month to get 50 bucks back."
            3. _ZTM - 96_, 14 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Have barely even used the app, I forgot to set up the notifications to have it delivered to me in my phone’s Focus settings, but this is not about that, this is about what they do when you give them your card details for a free trial. I got the one week and realized I just never saw the notifications for it, so I went to cancel it, and it gave me the option to extend it for one week, so I thought maybe, why not, and extended it and marked down the exact date it would renew, so I could go online and cancel it. Little did I know, they hid a whole other charge underneath the main one for the only app of theirs I had an account on, a “bundle” subscription on top of the one I was signing up for a trial for, for apps I did not even have. I never attempted to cancel that one because I didn’t even know I had given them consent to attempt to charge me for it at all. This morning, I received a message from my bank stating that they blocked a fraudulent charge, and a website’s name. Since I was not expecting any charges, because the date for the renewal was not for a week, I stated that it was not me who attempted the charge, and immediately my card got cancelled and now I have to wait around for a new one, and I have to go through and update my card information now for all my bills. All because of this incredibly deceptive and scammy app that I never even got around to using. I am irritated beyond measure and dearly hope they get hit with a class action lawsuit, any business this scummy with trying to get your money is not worth a cent on principle. If they had a product good enough, they would just be upfront about everything and allow the product to speak for itself, ESPECIALLY since it appears that they target ND people and those with ADHD, meaning they target those who are most likely to forget to track their subscriptions and how many times they got charged for something. Honestly, just disgusting overall and I am so irritated by the utter inconvenience, I would give it zero stars everywhere if I could. Never ever give them your card info, only get your free trials through the App Store and remember to cancel as soon as you decide it is not for you!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Примеры отзывов:**

The support team can’t access any screenshots you attach to their help request form, and they repeatedly email you asking for a description of the issue that you already described."
            2. _Grievousnix_, 25 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "One star, and only because zero isn't an option. The app itself is fine — but the subscription is a roach motel: easy to get in, engineered to be impossible to leave. Cancellation is buried behind dark patterns: guilt-trip screens, "are you sure you want to abandon your goals" prompts, hidden menus, and flows that loop you back instead of actually cancelling. A company confident in its product lets you leave in two taps. Fabulous instead bets you'll give up trying. I won't recommend an app that treats wanting to cancel as a bug to be patched out. Avoid until they make cancellation as frictionless as signup."
            3. _mink3eyki_, 27 июн. 2026 г., 2/5: "The App looks detailed and interesting but I’m very confused by the pricing. I click on one button for the membership it says ca. 70€, I click on another its 42€ something. I get a notification for a special deal, half price, since I gave feedback on the app but its somehow 52€, the next day I click on it it’s 48€? I actually want to buy the app but I feel I might get ripped off 😅 Edit: I got the app now for 39€.. but the “journey” is broken it only shows a white screen pls fix that Years later: wanted to Start again but the Same Price confusion (one Button Says 48€ another 39€).
